security.title: Security
security.intro: Protect how you sign in to Zentico. These settings apply to your whole account: mail, calendar, files and every app.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.onBody: When you sign in, after your password you're asked for a 6-digit code from your authenticator app. Someone who learns your password still can't get in.
twoFactor.offBody: Add a second step to sign-in: after your password, a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…). Even if someone learns your password, they can't get in.
twoFactor.verifyBody: To see or change your sign-in security, sign in again first.
twoFactor.step1: Scan this code with your authenticator app
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app:
twoFactor.step2: Enter the code the app shows, and your password
twoFactor.passwordHint: Only used to confirm this change; it isn't stored.
twoFactor.mailApps: Once this is on, mail apps that sign in with your password (Outlook, Apple Mail, Thunderbird over IMAP/SMTP) stop working. Give each of them an app password instead (Settings → Security → App passwords).
twoFactor.enabledNow: Two-step verification is on. You'll be asked for a code next time you sign in.
twoFactor.lostDevice: Lost your phone? Ask an administrator to reset two-step verification on your account, then sign in with your password and set it up again.
twoFactor.requiredByAdmin: Your administrator requires two-step verification, so it can't be turned off.
twoFactor.disableBody: Enter a current code from your app and your password.

errors.wrong_code: That code isn't right. Check that your phone's clock is correct and try again.
errors.wrong_credentials: The password or the code is incorrect.
errors.invalid: Enter the 6-digit code and your password.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.reauth: Your confirmation expired. Continue to confirm it's you again.
errors.authorize: Your confirmation expired. Continue to confirm it's you again.
errors.expired: The setup took too long. Start again.
errors.not_supported: Your account's sign-in is managed elsewhere, so it can't be changed here.
errors.signed_out: You're signed out. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Only workspace administrators can change this.
errors.quota: You've reached the maximum number of app passwords. Delete one first.
errors.account_mismatch: That confirmation was for a different account. Try again with {email}.
errors.verifyFailed: We couldn't check your sign-in security. Try again.

appPasswords.title: App passwords
appPasswords.body: For mail apps that can't ask for a code (IMAP, SMTP, CalDAV/CardDAV). Each one only works in apps, can't be used to sign in to Zentico, and can be deleted at any time.
appPasswords.verifyBody: Sign in again to see and manage your app passwords.
appPasswords.newBody: Paste it into your mail app's password field now. It won't be shown again.
appPasswords.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Apps using it will stop working.
appPasswords.name: Name, e.g. iPhone Mail

policy.title: Workspace policy
policy.requireHint: People without it are sent to set it up right after signing in, and can't use any app until they do (they can still sign out).
policy.sessionHint: How long people stay signed in, counted from when they signed in (not from their last activity). After that they sign in again, with their code if they use two-step verification. Applies to existing sessions too, including yours.
policy.membersHint: Status as of each person's last sign-in or visit to Security settings. People who haven't signed in since this feature arrived aren't listed.
policy.none: No one has been checked yet.

nudge.recommended: Protect your account: turn on two-step verification.
nudge.required: Your administrator requires two-step verification from {date}.

setupPage.title: Set up two-step verification
setupPage.body: Your workspace requires a second step at sign-in for {email}. Set it up to continue.
